brief:
Observe the directories a keeper has been working in, find the ones rich with un-minted skills (written methods that actually ran), draft SKILL.md packets from their evidence, and publish them into Skill Sync after review. Use when asked for a "spell search", to "survey my directories for skills", "mine this repo for skills", "make a skill out of this project/method", or when a project's method docs + run history deserve to become a shareable skill. Drafting is agent work; publishing rides the existing harvest → shelf → tailnet pipeline with its leak scan and PII neutralization. Vendored work is never ours to mint. Kept by the Librarian 🗃️; drafted in the Chronicler's hand.

**🧙📖🔍 Spell search — skills are spells that already worked** Keeper: the Librarian 🗃️ · Authored by the Chronicler 🧙📖 · Category: wikis · Layer: onboarding

> A spell is not what was planned; it is what was cast and held.
